description: Reviewed Captain list (compiler input): the great captains and leaders of 1997–2026, ranked, each with the World Cup cycles in which he led — his cards of those eras are Captains (app/data/eras.v1.json `captain: true`; the catalog player too when 2026 is one of them: catalog `captain: true`). The compiler takes the first `size` players and fails when an id, source name, nation or era of ANY entry does not match the data (so the cut can be moved without a surprise). Never a player of data/goats.json. `sofifaId` is EA’s player id (the person). `size` is the cut: the list is ranked for it — raise it to make Captains more frequent, lower it to make them rarer (docs/draft-api.md has the measured frequencies).

players.name: Paolo Maldini
players.reason: Il Capitano: Italy’s captain 1994–2002, Milan’s 1997–2009, lifted the Champions League as captain in 2003 and 2007.

players.name: Carles Puyol
players.reason: Barcelona’s captain 2004–14 through three Champions Leagues; the heart of Spain’s back line in 2008 and 2010.

players.name: Cafu
players.reason: Captain of the 2002 world champions, the only man to play three World Cup finals; Brazil’s captain to 2006.

players.name: Roy Keane
players.reason: Manchester United’s captain 1997–2005 (the Treble side’s driving force), Ireland’s captain: the type of the demanding leader.

players.name: Philipp Lahm
players.reason: Captain of the 2014 world champions and of Bayern’s 2013 treble side.

players.name: Sergio Ramos
players.reason: Real Madrid’s captain 2015–21 (three Champions Leagues in a row with the armband), Spain’s 2016–21.

players.name: Iker Casillas
players.reason: Captain of Spain’s Euro 2008, World Cup 2010 and Euro 2012 winners, and of Real Madrid.

players.name: Gianluigi Buffon
players.reason: Italy’s captain 2010–18, Juventus’s 2012–18; a GOAT keeper for many — kept here as a leader (the two lists cannot share a player).

players.name: Javier Zanetti
players.reason: Inter’s captain 2001–14 (the 2010 treble), 143 caps for Argentina: Il Capitano of the other half of Milan.

players.name: Fabio Cannavaro
players.reason: Captain of the 2006 world champions, Ballon d’Or for it.

players.name: Didier Deschamps
players.reason: Captain of France’s 1998 World Cup and Euro 2000 winners and of Marseille’s 1993 European champions.

players.name: Steven Gerrard
players.reason: Liverpool’s captain 2003–15 — Istanbul 2005 — and England’s at two World Cups.

players.name: Luka Modrić
players.reason: Croatia’s captain since 2016: the 2018 final (Golden Ball), third in 2022, still leading at 40.

players.name: Virgil van Dijk
players.reason: The Netherlands’ captain since 2018, Liverpool’s since 2023: the organiser of every defence he has played in.

players.name: John Terry
players.reason: Chelsea’s "Captain, Leader, Legend" 2004–17 (five titles, the 2012 Champions League), England’s captain 2006–12.

players.name: Patrick Vieira
players.reason: Captain of Arsenal’s Invincibles (2002–05) and of France (2006–09).

players.name: Vincent Kompany
players.reason: Manchester City’s captain 2011–19 (four titles), Belgium’s through its golden generation.

players.name: Hugo Lloris
players.reason: France’s record captain (2012–22): World Cup 2018, the final again in 2022.

players.name: Manuel Neuer
players.reason: Germany’s captain 2016–23 and Bayern’s since 2017 (the 2020 treble).

players.name: Oliver Kahn
players.reason: Der Titan: Bayern’s and Germany’s captain, carried Germany to the 2002 final (Golden Ball).

players.name: Francesco Totti
players.reason: Roma’s captain 1998–2017: the one-club captain of the modern game.

players.name: Thiago Silva
players.reason: O Monstro: captain of Brazil at three World Cups, of PSG for eight years, a leader at Chelsea at 36–39.

players.name: David Beckham
players.reason: England’s captain 2000–06: the free kick against Greece that took England to the 2002 World Cup.

players.name: Tony Adams
players.reason: Arsenal’s captain 1988–2002 (titles in three decades), England’s at Euro 96.

players.name: Fernando Hierro
players.reason: Real Madrid’s and Spain’s captain to 2002–03; three Champions Leagues.

players.name: Rafael Márquez
players.reason: El Káiser: Mexico’s captain at five World Cups (2002–18).

players.name: Giorgio Chiellini
players.reason: Juventus’s and Italy’s captain; lifted Euro 2020.

players.name: Diego Godín
players.reason: Uruguay’s captain 2014–22 and the leader of Simeone’s Atlético.

players.name: Lothar Matthäus
players.reason: Captain of the 1990 world champions, still Germany’s sweeper at the 1998 World Cup at 37.

players.name: Alessandro Del Piero
players.reason: Juventus’s captain 2001–12 — he stayed and led the club back up from Serie B.

players.name: Raúl
players.reason: Real Madrid’s captain 2003–10 and Spain’s 2002–06.

players.name: Harry Kane
players.reason: England’s captain since 2018 (a World Cup semi-final, two European finals) and its record scorer.

players.name: Joshua Kimmich
players.reason: Germany’s captain since 2024 and the voice of Bayern’s dressing room.

players.name: Son Heung-min
players.reason: Korea’s captain since 2018 and Tottenham’s when it won the 2025 Europa League.

players.name: Diego Simeone
players.reason: Argentina’s captain at the 1998 and 2002 World Cups.

players.name: Michael Ballack
players.reason: Germany’s Capitano 2004–10.

players.name: Didier Drogba
players.reason: Côte d’Ivoire’s captain 2006–14, the man who asked a country to lay down its arms; Chelsea’s leader in Munich 2012.

players.name: Nemanja Vidić
players.reason: Manchester United’s captain 2010–14, Serbia’s leader.

players.name: Peter Schmeichel
players.reason: Captain of Manchester United in the 1999 Champions League final; Denmark’s leader for a decade.

players.name: Marquinhos
players.reason: PSG’s captain since 2020 — lifted the club’s first Champions League in 2025; a captain of Brazil.

players.name: Frank de Boer
players.reason: The Netherlands’ captain at the 1998 World Cup and Euro 2000.

players.name: Zvonimir Boban
players.reason: Captain of the Croatia that finished third in 1998.

players.name: Javier Mascherano
players.reason: El Jefecito: Argentina’s captain 2008–11 and its leader in the 2014 final.

players.name: Alan Shearer
players.reason: England’s captain 1996–2000 and Newcastle’s for a decade.

players.name: Marcel Desailly
players.reason: France’s captain 2000–04 after Deschamps (Confederations Cups 2001 and 2003), Chelsea’s too.

players.name: Bastian Schweinsteiger
players.reason: The bloodied leader of the 2014 final; Germany’s captain 2014–16.

players.name: Jürgen Klinsmann
players.reason: Captain of Germany’s Euro 96 winners and at the 1998 World Cup.

players.name: Rigobert Song
players.reason: Cameroon’s captain for a decade: two Africa Cups (2000, 2002), four World Cups.

players.name: Jordan Henderson
players.reason: Liverpool’s captain 2015–23: the 2019 Champions League and the 2020 title, the club’s first in thirty years.

players.name: Kalidou Koulibaly
players.reason: Captain of Senegal’s first Africa Cup winners (2021).

players.name: Robert Lewandowski
players.reason: Poland’s captain since 2014 and its record scorer.

players.name: Makoto Hasebe
players.reason: Japan’s captain at three World Cups (2010–18).

players.name: Samuel Eto’o
players.reason: Cameroon’s captain 2009–14 and its greatest player.

players.name: Lúcio
players.reason: Brazil’s captain 2006–10 (Confederations Cup 2009) and a leader of Inter’s 2010 treble.

players.name: Roberto Ayala
players.reason: El Ratón: captained Argentina a record 63 times.

players.name: Jay-Jay Okocha
players.reason: Nigeria’s captain 2002–06.

players.name: Pavel Nedvěd
players.reason: The Czech captain 2000–06.

players.name: Andriy Shevchenko
players.reason: Captain of Ukraine’s only World Cup side (quarter-finals 2006).

players.name: Diego Lugano
players.reason: Uruguay’s captain in the 2010 semi-final and the 2011 Copa América win.

players.name: Simon Kjær
players.reason: Denmark’s captain: led his team through the night Eriksen collapsed and on to the Euro 2020 semi-final.

players.name: Martin Ødegaard
players.reason: Arsenal’s captain since 2022 and Norway’s since 2021.

players.name: Granit Xhaka
players.reason: Switzerland’s captain and record international; the leader of Leverkusen’s unbeaten 2024 champions.

players.name: Andrew Robertson
players.reason: Scotland’s captain since 2018: two European Championships after 23 years without a tournament.

players.name: Luís Figo
players.reason: Portugal’s captain at the 2006 World Cup (fourth place).

players.name: José Luis Chilavert
players.reason: Paraguay’s captain and loudest voice at the 1998 and 2002 World Cups.

players.name: Eden Hazard
players.reason: Belgium’s captain 2015–22: third at the 2018 World Cup with the armband.

players.name: Sergio Busquets
players.reason: Barcelona’s captain 2021–23 and Spain’s at the 2022 World Cup.

players.name: Claudio Bravo
players.reason: Captain of Chile’s only Copa América winners (2015 and 2016).

players.name: Daniele De Rossi
players.reason: Capitan Futuro: Roma’s captain after Totti, a leader of Italy for a decade.

players.name: Park Ji-sung
players.reason: Korea’s captain 2008–11.

players.name: Hong Myung-bo
players.reason: Captain of the Korea that reached the 2002 semi-final (his only card is of 2003–06).

players.name: Lucas Radebe
players.reason: The Chief: South Africa’s captain at two World Cups and Leeds United’s.

players.name: Gheorghe Hagi
players.reason: Romania’s captain through its best decade; Galatasaray’s leader in the 2000 UEFA Cup win.

players.name: Giovanni van Bronckhorst
players.reason: The Netherlands’ captain in the 2010 World Cup final.

players.name: Edin Džeko
players.reason: Bosnia and Herzegovina’s captain since 2014 and record scorer.

players.name: Gareth Bale
players.reason: Captain of the Wales that reached its first World Cup in 64 years.

players.name: Bruno Fernandes
players.reason: Manchester United’s captain since 2023.

players.name: Mohamed Salah
players.reason: Egypt’s captain since 2019.

players.name: Achraf Hakimi
players.reason: Morocco’s captain.

players.name: Gianluigi Donnarumma
players.reason: Italy’s captain since 2023.

players.name: Wayne Rooney
players.reason: England’s and Manchester United’s captain 2014–17.

players.name: Carlos Valderrama
players.reason: El Pibe: Colombia’s captain at three World Cups (1990–98).

players.name: Iván Zamorano
players.reason: Chile’s captain at the 1998 World Cup.

players.name: Mario Yepes
players.reason: Colombia’s captain in its best World Cup (quarter-finals 2014).

players.name: Andrés Guardado
players.reason: El Principito: Mexico’s captain, five World Cups.

players.name: Claudio Reyna
players.reason: Captain America: led the United States to the 2002 quarter-finals.

players.name: Christian Pulisic
players.reason: The face and frequent captain of the host nation’s side.
